name: rolling-desk
description: The producer's desk for a Rolling studio: the audio Console, show control, and every recording saved on this computer too.
author: Sam Fox (made with Claude, Anthropic)

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Rolling Desk uses your microphone only when you hold Talkback to speak to someone on the show.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Rolling Desk doesn't record you; the camera is only used if you join the show on camera.

linux.synopsis: Producer's desk for a Rolling podcast studio
